scripts.build: npm run build:legacy && cross-env OPENAPPS_BUILD_PHASE=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next build --webpack
scripts.build:legacy: npm run build -w frontend && npm run sync-docs -w @openapps/docs-site && npm run build -w @openapps/docs-site && node scripts/sync-legacy-assets.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:legacy && cross-env CLOUDFLARE_CONFIG_PATH=wrangler.local.jsonc NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next dev
scripts.deploy: npm run migrate:remote && npm run build:cloudflare && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.migrate:local: cross-env CLOUDFLARE_CONFIG_PATH=wrangler.local.jsonc PAYLOAD_SECRET=local-development-secret NODE_ENV=development payload migrate && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.migrate:remote: cross-env NODE_ENV=production payload migrate && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler d1 execute DB --command 'PRAGMA optimize' --remote
